author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Fifty-One! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

Malev's One Box Wargame challenge produced over a hundred incredibly fun, clever and easy to play games to check out last year. Mike's entry takes the core Gasland Mechanics and expands on them into a whacky Post Apocalyptic NAVAL COMBAT way. Let's dive in and check it out!

Check out the rulebooks in digital  HERE: https://planetsmashergames.itch.io/rad-pirates-of-the-toxic-sands

The Warlord Games Kit is HERE: https://us.warlordgames.com/products/frigates-brigs-flotilla-1770-1830?srsltid=AfmBOopccWXQtPmwAIl3UJlZe0gynzp2u0_E0PQmui_1Yjbbt5FhrSMy
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 051 - Rad Pirates of the Toxic Sands  by Mike Hutchinson
